ui_state.answer: A) Delta is 0.25 shares per option (25 shares per 100-share contract) and the call price is $0.633 ($63.30 per contract). Delta = (1 - 0)/(22 - 18) = 0.25. Risk-neutral probability p = (e^0.03 - 0.90)/(1.10 - 0.90) = 0.6523, yielding f = e^(-0.03) * 0.6523 * $1.00 = $0.633.

data.answer: A) Delta is 0.25 shares per option (25 shares per 100-share contract) and the call price is $0.633 ($63.30 per contract). Delta = (1 - 0)/(22 - 18) = 0.25. Risk-neutral probability p = (e^0.03 - 0.90)/(1.10 - 0.90) = 0.6523, yielding f = e^(-0.03) * 0.6523 * $1.00 = $0.633.
